theme.description: A premium, sleek gamer/SaaS control panel designed for developers. Avoids generic SaaS templates. Focus on high-contrast data legibility, terminal-inspired details for logs, and a dark tactical aesthetic.

surfaces.cards: Flat background with 1px solid border (border-border), no soft drop shadows. Sharp and technical.
surfaces.modals: Crystal Glass effect: backdrop-blur-xl with semi-transparent background (bg-black/60 in dark, bg-white/70 in light). 1px inner stroke.
surfaces.sidebar: Subtle border-r to separate from main content. Uses background color slightly offset from main bg if needed.

effects.glow: Use subtle drop-shadows on active status badges (e.g. drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,230,118,0.5)]) in dark mode to mimic LEDs.
effects.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and border color illumination on cards. Interactive rows should have bg-muted/50 on hover.

grids_and_layouts.general: Mobile-first responsive. Container padding p-4 md:p-8.
grids_and_layouts.feature_flags_grid: Dense grid for 24 toggles: grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Each toggle in a compact flex container with a border and subtle bg.
grids_and_layouts.tables: Full width, text-left. Use JetBrains Mono for IPs, versions, and HWID columns. Fixed headers if possible.

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Use for Total Users, Active, Banned. Technical look.
components.styling: border border-border bg-surface p-6 rounded-lg. Top label: tiny uppercase. Metric: text-4xl JetBrains Mono. Include small trend indicator (+5%).

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: For Active, Banned, Expired, Disabled states.
components.styling: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold. Dark mode Active: bg-[#00E676]/10 text-[#00E676] border border-[#00E676]/20.

components.name: Feature Flag Toggle
components.description: Sleek switch for cheating features (Aimbot, ESP, etc.)
components.styling: Shadcn Switch customized to brand colors. Label uses technical font. Container p-3 border border-border rounded-md hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors.

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Used for Users, Login Logs, Client Versions.
components.styling: border-collapse. th: uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground bg-muted/20. td: py-3 border-b border-border.

motion.hover_states: Fast and snappy. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for table rows and grid cards (framer-motion).
motion.modals: Fade in with a slight scale up (0.95 to 1).

login_background.description: Abstract geometric shapes formed by neon strip lights in dark setting.
login_background.instructions: Use as a full-cover background image on the login screen. Apply a heavy overlay (e.g., bg-black/70 or a radial gradient) so the login panel and text remain 100% accessible and high contrast.

styling.tooltip: Dark mode tooltips must have solid bg-surface, border, and white text. No transparent tooltips.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark surfaces meets at least 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='toggle-aimbot').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural layout and Shadcn for interactive pieces (Tables, Modals, Switches, Forms, Drawers).
Implement a robust Dark/Light mode toggle in the top bar using next-themes or raw React state. Default to dark mode.
Design the Sidebar as a persistent navigation menu on the left, top bar for user profile/theme/logout.
In the Users table, clicking 'Edit' should open a Drawer or Modal. This modal needs a 24-item grid of boolean Feature Flags (use Shadcn Switch) and text inputs for Expiry/HWID.
Avoid default purple/blue gradients. Stick to the stark, technical Void Black / Cyan / Neon Green / Crimson palette.
Include recharts for the login-activity trend chart and package distribution donut on the Overview page.
Ensure 'JetBrains Mono' is applied to data points like IPs, HWIDs, and version hashes to give a terminal/developer feel.
Include Fontshare CDN in index.css for Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi. Include Google Fonts for JetBrains Mono. Set them up in tailwind.config.js.
For icons, install and use lucide-react. Do NOT use emojis.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply global `transition: all` as it breaks transforms.
Never center align the main app container. Let the layout breathe with grid and flexbox.
Do not use generic emoji for icons. Use lucide-react.
Always apply hover, focus, and active states to interactive elements.
Use 2x-3x more spacing (e.g., p-6 or p-8) than typical tight designs to look premium.
Add layered styling to Modals and Drawers (glassmorphism in dark mode).
Ensure all mock data looks realistic (real looking IPs, hashes, game cheat names like 'AimbotExternal', 'NoRecoil').
